basic_details.job_title: GRSE Chairman & Managing Director Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Limited (GRSE) has announced the GRSE Chairman & Managing Director Recruitment 2026 under Notification No. 6/14/2026-PESB for vacancy. Eligible candidates with the required qualifications and relevant senior-level experience can apply online through the Public Enterprises Selection Board (PESB) website, pesb.gov.in. The post offers a pay scale of Rs. 2,00,000–3,70,000 (IDA), with a tenure of up to five years, subject to the prescribed conditions. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must meet the following eligibility conditions regarding age, employment status, qualification, and experience: Engineering Graduate or Chartered Accountant or Cost Accountant or Post Graduate or Graduate with MBA/ PGDIM from a recognized institute. Applicants having Post Graduate degree in Naval/ Electrical/ Electronics/ Mechanical/ Marine Engineering will have added advantage. Experience in Ship Design/ Ship Building/ Ship Repairs will be preferred. The applicant must be employed in a regular capacity in a Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE), Central Government Group 'A' Officers including Armed Forces and All India Services, Public Sector Banks/ Financial Institutions/ Autonomous Bodies, State Public Sector Enterprise (SPSE) with an annual turnover of *Rs. 5,000 crore or more, or Private Sector Company/ Joint Venture (50:50 JVs of Central/State Governments or JVs of CPSEs with other CPSEs/organisations) / National and State level Cooperative Federations whose annual turnover is *Rs. 5000 crore or more (*average audited annual turnover of three financial years preceding the calendar year in which the post is advertised).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The post carries a scale of pay of Rs. 200000 - 370000 (IDA). The appointment shall be for a period of five years from the date of joining or up to the date of superannuation or until further orders, whichever is earlier. Central Government officers, including those of the Armed Forces and All India Services and officers from Public Sector Banks/ Financial Institutions/ Autonomous Bodies etc., will be eligible for consideration only on immediate absorption basis. content_sections.heading: The Role
content_sections.text: The Chairman and Managing Director, GRSE, is the Chief Executive of the Company and accountable to its Board of Directors and Government/ Shareholders. He/She is responsible for the efficient functioning of the Company, and for achieving its corporate objectives and performances parameters.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GRSE Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill up the Application Form online only on the website of PESB at https://pesb.gov.in/ . Ensure the application is forwarded online by the nodal officer/ competent authority as specified in the notification. Applicants from Private Companies/ JVs/ Federations must submit required documents including annual reports of three financial years, documentary proof of company listing, evidence of working at Board level, self-attested copies of age and qualification documents, and relevant jobs handled details along with the application form.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted for interview by the Board, keeping in view the extant guidelines issued from time to time.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply online for GRSE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online application by the applicant is 02.11.2026 up to 03:00 PM, and the last date for nodal officers to forward online applications is 11.11.2026 up to 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the pay scale for the Chairman & Managing Director post at GRSE?
faq.answer: The post carries an IDA pay scale of Rs. 200000 - 370000.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum and maximum age limits for internal and other candidates?
faq.answer: The minimum age for both internal and other candidates is 45 years. For internal candidates, the maximum age requires 2 years residual service as on the date of vacancy w.r.t. the date of superannuation, while for others it requires 3 years residual service.

faq.question: Q4. Is prior experience in ship design or shipbuilding mandatory?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess cumulative experience for at least 5 years during the last 10 years in Finance, Business Development, Production, Operations, Marketing, Project Management, Ship Design, Shipbuilding, or Ship Repairs in a large organization of repute, with experience in ship design, building, or repairs being preferred.

faq.question: Q5. What is the duration of the appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment shall be for a period of five years from the date of joining or up to the date of superannuation or until further orders, whichever is earlier.
